digest.component_or_area: MCP server factory and Pydantic settings integration
propositions: MCP v1.29.0 Settings model defines a generic lifespan field as an unresolved ForwardRef before FastMCP class is defined, leaving Settings.model_fields incomplete after postponed annotations are enabled.

First construction of FastMCP through rebar.mcp_server.build_server() triggers IncompleteFieldDefinitionWarning from pydantic-settings 2.15 when that warning is promoted to error, aborting server initialization.
Calling Settings.model_rebuild() after import resolves the forward reference and prevents the warning on first FastMCP construction without changing runtime behavior, schema, or lifecycle.
The defect is specific to MCP 1.x and pydantic-settings 2.15; direct upstream FastMCP reproduction confirmed the root cause is not in rebar configuration, Starlette integration, or schema design.
